Container.Name: crayon-box-sync
Container.Overview: Family sync for Crayon Box, the kids' coloring app (ADR 0024). Keeps kid profiles, settings and pictures the same on every paired device. Home network only: do not expose it to the internet. Open the WebUI for the pairing code.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Where the app reaches the server

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The database and pictures. Include it in your appdata backup.

Config.Name: Pairing code
Config.Description: Optional: a fixed pairing code. Leave empty to use the one the server makes on first start (shown on the WebUI).
